result.reason: The language substantially reaches the preferred position for termination: six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, data return within 30 days in a machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter. However, paragraph (c) is triggered only “Upon termination.” The isolated reference to “such expiration or termination” does not clearly make the obligations apply upon expiry and lacks an antecedent for “such expiration.” In addition, transition assistance is not expressly carved out from subsection (i), which requires Kubient to cease providing the Services. These operative defects prevent full compliance despite the margin comment.
